item.title: Saskatchewan NDP calls for emergency legislative session over proposed rate hikes
item.description: REGINA — Saskatchewan's Opposition is calling for emergency action on rising prices, but Premier Scott Moe's government says the work is being done and NDP Leader Carla Beck needs to start showing up to debate.

item.title: Surging Kraken score four times in third period to burn Flames 5-1
item.description: CALGARY — Shane Wright scored the go-ahead goal in the third period and Philipp Grubauer made 41 saves to lead the streaking Seattle Kraken to a 5-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

item.title: 'Frostbite capital': Efforts to reduce frostbite amputations underway in Edmonton
item.description: EDMONTON — Trevor Logan winces in pain as a nurse cleans the blistered middle finger on his right hand, swollen to twice its size due to frostbite.

item.title: B.C. approves extending life of Mt. Milligan copper-gold mine to 2035
item.description: VICTORIA — British Columbia's Environmental Assessment Office says it has approved an extension for the life of the Mount Milligan copper and gold mine near Fort St. James into 2035.

item.title: Sweden beats Czechia 4-2 for its 3rd world junior hockey title
item.description: ST. PAUL, Minn. (AP) — Casper Juustovaara and Viktor Eklund scored first-period goals and Sweden won its third world junior hockey title, beating Czechia 4-2 on Monday night in the first all-European final since 2016.

item.title: The most interesting tech we saw on day one of CES
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Sure, Nvidia, AMD and Intel all had important chip and AI platform announcements on the first day of CES 2026, but all audiences wanted to see more of was Star Wars and Jensen Huang's little robot buddies.

item.title: Sourdif scores his first hat trick to lead Capitals over Ducks
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Justin Sourdif scored his first NHL hat trick and added two assists and the Washington Capitals beat the Anaheim Ducks 7-4 on Monday night.
